description.value: Riverway Restaurant is a City of Burnaby-operated dining room situated at the Riverway Clubhouse golf facility, part of the Burnaby Hospitality group that manages several restaurants, venues, and accommodations across the city. The restaurant is marketed as offering West Coast-inspired cuisine in a scenic setting among rolling hills and trees. It sits alongside a cluster of other city-run food and event facilities, making it a notable stop in Burnaby's park and recreation corridor.
